field_grades.art: measured (u32 at byte 12 of the shot row, chr/shot/<prefix>.bin)
field_grades.effect_class: inferred (a summary of the kinds in the row)
field_grades.grade: measured for decoded args; lead for every other op 3 arg
field_grades.guide_check: measured join: the GameFAQs select tag against the anim 0x18 rows of the mapped prefixes
field_grades.has_kb_record: inferred: kb_recs is non-empty (the art low byte = anim id join, review c4; see grade_notes.spawn)
field_grades.kb_recs: inferred: the knockback records whose collision track keys an anim equal to the art low byte (review c4)
field_grades.kind: inferred (the name of each op 3 arg, from the handler it calls)
field_grades.units: inferred (HP raw / 64 per displayed HP; SP raw / 25600 per bar, uare2-findings §3)
field_grades.x_raw: inferred (ev[2] * 32; the shift is read from the handler, review.md f1)
field_grades.y_raw: inferred (ev[3] * -126; the multiplier is read from mvn r0,#0x7d at 0x021566F4)

grade_notes.arm_substitute: measured: arg 9 stores the decoy index (signed ev[4]) and arms the substitution (0x02157C4C -> 0x0215C034); behaviour is in uare2-findings §1
grade_notes.guide: measured join: each GameFAQs select tag maps to the prefixes of mash_table.GUIDE_FILES
grade_notes.hp: measured: arg 23 applies s16 ev[4..5] to the active koma's HP (0x02157DB8 -> 0x020783CC)
grade_notes.impulse: measured bytes: op 1 sub 3 (table 0x02172020[3] = 0x0215669C); x = ev[2] * 32 and y = ev[3] * -126 are the handler's arithmetic, read statically
grade_notes.invuln: measured: arg 7 stores s16 ev[4..5] to +0xCE (0x02157C30)
grade_notes.lead: args 17 and 18 and any other op 3 arg: bytes measured, semantics not traced
grade_notes.sp: measured: arg 24 applies s16 ev[4..5] to the team SP pool (0x02157DC8 -> 0x020781E4)
grade_notes.spawn: measured bytes: the shot row (ev[4]) and its art (u32 at byte 12). kb join inferred: the art's low byte is an anim id, and kb_recs lists each knockback record whose collision track keys that anim (K.record_uses; review c4). Inferred, not proven, and it can be ambiguous: several records can match (ds_b_01 -> [11, 15]). has_kb_record is null only when the row is not in the file
grade_notes.status: inferred (static only): arg 10 maps its u16 operand ev[4..5] through the byte table at 0x0217215C (26 bytes, pinned in code_facts) and calls 0x02158ED0(self, id) (0x02157C5C); the status lands on the acting fighter. No capture of the landing
grade_notes.store: measured bytes: sub 19 writes ev[2] (signed) to the team register ctrl+0xA3 (0x021560EC); the register is -1 at init (0x0215542C) and survives switches and hits (review.md b3-b5)
grade_notes.stored_jump: measured bytes: sub 20 reads ctrl+0xA3; if it is not -1 it queues a jump to that Marker and resets it to -1 (0x021560F8). `targets` lists every Marker of the anim
grade_notes.trigger: measured: SELECT edge 0x1000 at 0x0215A7D0 (tst r0,#0x1000) returns move id 11 (anim 0x18, state 0x0C, no SP gate); the air reader returns only ids 9 and 10
